patches.name: Animated profile covers
patches.description: Plays the short animation TikTok used to show in each video's preview on a profile grid. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Centered comment menu
patches.description: Shows the menu a press and hold on a comment opens as a window in the middle of the screen, as it used to be, instead of a sheet along the bottom.

patches.name: Comment menu rows
patches.description: Lets you pick which rows the menu a press and hold on a comment opens shows. The rows are read from the menu itself as it opens, so nothing is fixed in the patch: the list in the Pixkk Patches settings holds every row the menu has shown.

patches.name: Discover tab
patches.description: Puts the Discover tab (the compass) in the bottom bar where Friends is. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Don't open comments on icon swipe
patches.description: Lets a swipe that starts on one of the buttons down the right of a video (avatar, like, comments, save, share) scroll to the next video, instead of pressing the button when the finger comes up. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Expand description in place
patches.description: Makes See more unfold the description right where it is, the way TikTok used to, instead of opening the full text in a new screen. Starts off. Turn it on in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Favorites button in share menu
patches.description: Puts the Add to favorites button into the share menu's bottom row, in the place you choose. The place is set in the Pixkk Patches settings.

options.description: Where the button goes in the bottom row, counted from the left from 1 (Report is 1). A place past the last button puts it last; 0 leaves it out. A patched app starts with it until it is changed on the settings page.

patches.name: Old-style counts
patches.description: Writes long like, comment and other counts as 12.3K and 1.2M in every language, not with the language's own word for thousand. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Old-style seeking
patches.description: Dragging along the progress bar in the feed puts the video where your finger is on the bar, as TikTok used to, instead of moving it by how far the finger travels. It can be turned off in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: Right column spacing
patches.description: Lets you widen or close up the gap between the buttons down the right of a video: avatar, like, comments, save and share. The gap is set in the Pixkk Patches settings, and 0 leaves TikTok's own spacing.

options.description: From -30 to 60. 0 leaves TikTok's own spacing.

patches.name: Scroll sound name
patches.description: Scrolls a sound name that is wider than its row along the row, the way the feed did before the redesign, instead of ending it in dots. The speed is set in the Pixkk Patches settings. Starts off. Turn it on there.

options.description: How fast the name scrolls, from 10 to 200. A patched app starts with it until it is changed on the settings page.

patches.name: Settings menu row
patches.description: Adds a Pixkk Patches row to the profile's side menu, right under Settings and privacy.

patches.name: Sound name under description
patches.description: Shows the video's sound name on its own line under the description, the way the feed did before the redesign. Starts off. Turn it on in the Pixkk Patches settings.

patches.name: pixkk settings row
patches.description: Turns the What's New row in Settings and privacy into the Pixkk Patches settings.
